summary: Iter 54 — Customer Booking-Login Workflow validated end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass in test_iter54_customer_booking_workflow.py covering login (OTP disabled) -> /auth/me -> /marketplace/search -> /marketplace/book -> /bookings/inquiry/{id}/status -> /customer/trips/{id}/payment-info -> /payments/gateways -> /payments/wallet/apply -> /razorpay/create-order (returns order_id + key_id + amount_paise) -> /payments/stripe/checkout (returns checkout_url) -> /customer/trips (My Bookings visibility) -> /marketplace/auction/start. Frontend: customer login lands on /customer without OTP, JWT persisted in localStorage, /booking wizard step 1-2 navigable, /customer/trips renders. All three payment gateways backing APIs are functional (razorpay+stripe enabled, cashfree+paypal disabled by config, wallet handled by /payments/wallet/apply endpoint separately). The user's request 'Customer Booking Login Workflow 100% working or not' — Answer: YES, 100% working at API level and login/session/booking wizard load level.

minor.issue: 'wallet' is not listed in /payments/gateways response (only razorpay, stripe, cashfree, paypal). PaymentPage.js applies wallet via a separate /payments/wallet/apply endpoint so functionality is not broken, but frontend has a fallback that hides wallet if not enumerated. Consider adding wallet as a virtual gateway entry when balance>0.

issues: Flight Type / Booking For / Booking Purpose use native browser <select> dropdowns instead of shadcn Select — violates code_review_guidelines (browser default pickers). Cosmetic only, wizard still advances.

No data-testid attributes on wizard step buttons/inputs (Next, Previous, service cards, selects) — makes E2E test authoring brittle. Consider adding data-testid to at least: service-card-{type}, wizard-next-btn, wizard-prev-btn, flight-type-select, booking-for-select, booking-purpose-select.

verifications_performed.login: POST /api/auth/login {customer@airyatra.co.in, Customer@123} -> 200 with access_token (JWT). No OTP challenge (LOGIN_OTP_ENABLED=false verified). /auth/me returns email + roles including 'customer'.
verifications_performed.marketplace_search: POST /api/marketplace/search (helicopter Mumbai->Pune, +7d) -> 200 mode='marketplace' or 'auction' with feasibility{feasible, distance_km, estimated_flight_minutes} and options[] array; price_lock_minutes=15.
verifications_performed.instant_book: POST /api/marketplace/book with aircraft_id -> 200 success:true, returns booking_id (uuid), booking_number (MKT-prefixed), total_amount, price_lock_expires_at (+15min), payment_url=/customer/payment/{id}. Inquiry persisted to db.inquiries.
verifications_performed.inquiry_status: GET /api/bookings/inquiry/{id}/status -> 200 with inquiry object matching created booking_id/number.
verifications_performed.payment_info: GET /api/customer/trips/{id}/payment-info -> 200 with amount/pricing breakdown fields present.
verifications_performed.payment_gateways: GET /api/payments/gateways -> 200 gateways=[razorpay (enabled, badge=Recommended, methods=upi/card/netbanking/wallet/emi), stripe (enabled, Test Mode, card), cashfree (disabled), paypal (disabled)]. Wallet is NOT enumerated here — handled via /payments/wallet/apply.
verifications_performed.wallet_apply: POST /api/payments/wallet/apply {booking_id} -> handled gracefully (200 or 400 based on balance).
verifications_performed.razorpay_create_order: POST /api/razorpay/create-order -> 200 {order_id, key_id, amount_paise, prefill, theme}. Backend prefix is /razorpay (NOT /payments/razorpay as feature spec assumed). Frontend PaymentPage.js correctly calls /razorpay/create-order.
verifications_performed.stripe_checkout: POST /api/payments/stripe/checkout {booking_id, origin_url, payment_type:advance} -> 200 with valid https checkout_url.
verifications_performed.my_bookings: GET /api/customer/trips -> 200 list includes newly-created booking (id + booking_number match).
verifications_performed.auction_flow: POST /api/marketplace/auction/start (chartered_plane Delhi->Bangalore, +10d, max_budget=500000) -> 200 success:true; inquiry created for reverse auction bridge.
verifications_performed.session_persistence: Frontend UI: login -> /customer, page reload retains token in localStorage, /customer/trips accessible without re-auth. JWT sent in Authorization header on all API calls.
verifications_performed.frontend_booking_wizard: BookingPage.js loads at /booking after auth. Step1 (Passengers) renders 6 service cards (helicopter/private-jet/air-ambulance/yacht/cargo/joy-ride) + male/female counters. Next advances to Step2 (Booking Type + Flight Type/Booking For/Booking Purpose selects + One-Way tile). No JS errors in console.
